label: B1 · STRESS
text: The preferred commercial signing service announces that the current API will be deprecated in 12 months. Migration to the new API is possible, but requires a new adapter and retesting. The vendor will continue security updates, but will not provide source code or long-term compatibility guarantees.
principle: Reuse transfers some development work into dependency and lifecycle risk. Re-evaluate the decision boundary, not just the initial delivery deadline.
